CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.
   D. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The little? (1 mark)
   A. Say The little has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The little to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The little.
   D. Apply the teaching of The little with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible.
   B. Say Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

7. Which response best shows understanding of The good life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)

   B. Say Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

   D. Use Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
